content: Jesus, Dinjii Vizhit Ch'anky'aa Iizųų Lęįį Tr'iinlii
Ąįįtł'ęę van ndųhts'ąįį Gerasa nahkat ąįį zhit k'eegiidal.
Nijin Jesus, tr'ihchoh zhit gwats'an deiinzhii dąį' dinjii vizhit ch'anky'aa iizųų ąįį, kii ch'a'an zhit tth'an k'it goodlii gwats'an khaiinzhii ts'ą' yats'ą' tr'iinzhii,
ąįį tth'an k'it gwa'an gwitee gwich'įį ts'ą' juu nąįį datthak ch'iitsii tły'ah haa dineegiiyahchaa googaa khyų' giiyųųntą'.

Deegwahtł'oo giiyanli', ts'ą' giikwai' haa ch'iitsii tły'ah haa dineegiiyahchal, googaa nihk'it ch'iitsii tły'ah łahnaii gwats'an tr'inidik. It'ee shrit nint'aii ts'ąįį k'iizhak giiyahoontą' geenjit gaa gwagwantrii.
Tǫǫ ts'ą' drin haa tth'ank'it gwitee, ts'ą' taih tee haa gwa'an neehihdik ts'ą' azhral ts'ą' kii haa datthąį' khadant'ii.
Nijin shriit'ąhthee ahaa gwiizhit, Jesus neeł'in dąį' yats'ą' hilgik ts'ą' yats'ą' nikiigwiintthaii,

ts'ą' gwint'aii azhral ts'ą' jyaa nyąą, “Jesus, Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa Jiintsii, Vidinji' inlii, deeshahah'yaa eenjit t'ini'in? Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vik'iighai' nadach'ooshakwat t'inyąą khaiinjich'ashǫhthat shrǫ'!”
Ąįį jyaa nyąą geh'an Jesus jii jyaa nyąą, “Ch'anky'aa iizųų, jii dinjii vizhit gwats'an khaiinkhaii.” yahnyąą.
Jesus yuahkat, “Noozhri' doozhii?” Ąįį dinjii yidii ginkhe', “Shoozhri' Legion (niveet'ah'in lęįį) oaazhii, it'ee shrit tr'iinlęįį ts'ąįį jyąhts'ą' diinoozhri' t'oonchy'aa!”
Ąįį dinjii vizhit ch'anky'aa iizųų kwaii, Jesus ts'ą' gwintł'oo ch'oodigiikwat, “Dzaa nahkat gwats'an gihłeediihoiinlyaa shrǫ'!” yahnyąą.
Izhik geeghaih gwa'an taih khyųų pig lęįį kwaii ch'a'aa.
Ąįįts'ą' zhit ch'anky'aa iizųų nąįį Jesus eech'oodigiikwat ts'ą' t'iginyąą, “Pig kwaii ts'ą' tr'iheedaa ts'ą' goozhit direheedhaa.” ginyąą.

Ąįį gwik'it t'igiizhik goots'an gwiłtsąįį, ąįį dinjii ts'an tr'ineegiijil ts'ą' pig kwaii zhit digiindhat. Ąįį pigs naatł'ii 2,000 aanchy'aa kwaii datthak taihdik gwats'an van zhit oondaa gahaajil ts'ą' teenagahoonii.

Ąįį pigs k'ąąhtii nąįį datthak gihłeegalgihiljil ts'ą' zhat kwaiik'it gwatsal gwitee gwich'įį nąįį ts'ą' zhat gwa'an juu gwanzhįh nahshii gwich'įį nąįį datthak haa gwagwaandak, ts'ą' dinjii nąįį deegwiizhik t'igwinyąą li' geenjit gwagwahąąh'yaa gwats'an gahaajil.

Zhat gwa'an dinjii nąįį datthak Jesus ts'ą' gahaajil, ąįį dinjii vizhit ch'anky'aa iizųų lęįį yizhit t'inchy'aa chy'ah, giiyąąh'in, akhai' veenjit gwinzii ts'ą' gwinzii chan niinjich'adhat ts'ą' zhat dhidii, ts'ą' gwach'aa naazhii. Dinjii nąįį datthak gwagwah'in dąį' gąąnjat nagaanaii.
Dinjii datthak gwehkįį deegwiizhik gwagwąąh'ya' nąįį, dinjii zhat nijyaa nąįį datthak zhit dinjii ts'ą' pigs haa deegiizhik goovaagwagwaandak.
Ąįįts'ą' zhat dinjii nąįį datthak Jesus diinahkat gihłeehindii agahnyąą.
It'ee Jesus tr'ihchoh zhit neehidii gwiizhit, ąįį dinjii vizhit ch'anky'aa iizųų tr'iniinlii chy'ah yach'adookwat ts'ą' jyaa nyąą, “Naa neeshozhi'” yahnyąą.
Gaa Jesus jyaa yahnyąą, “Nakwaa! Nizheh gwits'ee hindii ts'ą' nizheh k'ąą nąįį K'eegwaadhat deegwahtł'oo neeshraahchy'aa noonyąą ts'ą' neenjit deezhik datthak goovaagwandak.”
Ąįįts'ą', ąįį dinjii Decapolis nahkat gwitee haazhii ts'ą' Jesus yeenjit deezhik datthak geegwaandak. Juu yiitth'ak nąįį datthak łahchy'aa gooveenjit geegagoolii kwaa t'igwiizhik.
Dinjii Jairus Vigii Nich'it Tsal ąįįts'ą' Tr'injaa Juu Jesus Vagwach'aa Kat Naanjik
Nijin Jesus, van ndųhts'ąįį gwits'ee hoozhii dąį' aiizhit van vee gwa'an, dinjii lęįį nąįį yeelin łeeljil.
Ąįįtł'ęę nijin Jews' tr'igiinkhii zheh gwizhit gwats'ą' k'eedeegwaadhat ch'ihłee Jairus oozhii zhat k'idik dąį', Jesus neeł'in gwagwahkhan, yakwai' eeghaii nikiigwiintthaii ts'ą',
Jesus ts'ą' ch'oodiikwat haa yuahkat, “Shigii nich'it tsal gwint'aii iłts'ik, Ąįį vakat nahaandal ts'ą' veenjit gwinzii neegwahahtsyaa geenjit shaa hinkhaii!” yahnyąą.
Ąįįts'ą' Jesus yaa haazhii, dinjii lęįį vaa adaa ts'ąįį nihłehjuk datthak an giiyahtrak.
Gootee tr'injaa ch'ihłak niighyuk (12 years) datthak gwintł'oo, dah vats'an an ilii haa khaiinjich'iighit.
Dinjii iłts'ik shrinilik nilii nąįį ts'ą' łyaa dalaraa datthak an iłtsąįį, gaa giiyeenjit gwinzii neegwąhtsii kwaa, ąįįts'ą' gwandaa veenjit gwiizųų gwilii.
Jesus, eenjit gwiitth'ak ts'ą' dinjii lęįį łeeljil tee gwats'an yant'ii niinzhii,
“Vagwach'aa kat naaljik ji' gaa sheenjit gwinzii neegweheelyaa gwizhrįh.” adaa nyąą.
Ąįįts'ą' yi'ik kat naanjik, gwagwahkhan vadaa an ilii kwaa nagwaanąįį, veenjit gwinzii neegahoodlit łee dizhit gwats'an idiky'aanjik.
Gwagwahkhan dinjii gwanlii tee Jesus vat'aii kwaa nagwaanąįį. Giky'aanjik gwagwahkhan łihts'eediil'ee ts'ą' ch'oahkat, “Juu shagwach'aa kat naanjik?”
“Dinjii neelin gwanlii gwiizhit jaghaii juu nakat naanjik, diinyąą ts'ą' ch'oahkat?” vitsyaa nąįį giiyahnyąą.
Googaa nihk'it Jesus juu t'iizhik li' geenjit gootee gwąąh'in.
Nijin tr'injaa vats'a' deegwiizhit gwiky'aanjik dąį', najat haa daatrat gwiizhit gaa Jesus eeninzhii ts'ą', yikwaiichan nikiigwiintthaii ts'ą' łi'deegwidlii haa deegwiizhii datthak yaagwaandak.
“Shichi', nigwik'iinjigwiighit k'iighai' neenjit gwinzii neegahoodlit ąįįts'ą' nidivee gwiizųų datthak gwinzii neegahoodlit, shigii tsinehdan haa oo'an neehiindii,” Jesus, yahnyąą.

Tth'aii hee ginkhii gwiizhit, Jairus vizheh gwats'ąnh dinjii lat nąįį k'eegiidal ts'ą' Jairus jyaa agahnyąą, “Nigii nich'it tsal ch'adąį' hee niindhat t'oonchy'aa. Jaghaii ąįį geech'ǫąąhtan vaandeegwiin'ąįį?”
Gaa Jesus, deeginyąą zhyaa gwiitth'ak ts'ą' Jairus ąįį t'ahnyąą, “Nanjat kwaa ts'ą' gwik'injiinghit gwizhrįh t'inchy'aa!” yahnyąą.
Ąįįtł'ęę, Peter, James ts'ą' vachaa John nąįį zhrįh giiyaaheedaa gwiłtsąįį.
Nijin Jairus vizheh k'eegiidal dąį' zhat dinjii nąįį gitree, ts'ą' tree'yaa dha'aii gwiizhit gwinzii goovaa goo'aii kwaa, Jesus goovah'in,
ąįįts'ą' nijin nihdeiinzhii dąį' t'agavahnyąą, “Jaghaii nakhwaa gwinzii goo'aii kwaa, ts'ą' ohtree? Jii nich'it tsal niindhat kwaa gąą zhyaa dhichįį t'inchy'aa.” gavahnyąą.

Ąįįts'ą', ąįį zhit zhat, Jesus deenyąą eenjit giiyeedlaa. Ąįįts'ą' datthak cheegoovahaadlii, ts'ą' zhit nich'it tsal, viti' ts'ą' vahan, ts'ą' ditsyaa tik nąįį zhrįh dahaa nihdeiinlii. Ąįįts'ą' nijin nich'it tsal gilt'aii gwats'ą' haazhii ts'ą',
yanli' oonjik ts'ą' t'iiyahnyąą, “Talitha Koum!” (Jii t'ee “Nich'it tsal khakeena'ąįį naihnyąą!” gwinyąą t'igwinyąą.)
Zhat gwagwahkhan ndak needhijin ts'ą' zhat gwa'an neehidik. (12 years old nilii jyaa digwiizhit dąį'.) Zhat łyaa datthak goovaa nindal gwaazhit.
Gaa Jesus t'agavahnyąą, “Łyaa zhyaa ch'ihłak gaa haa goondak shrǫ'! Shih yihee'aa, ji' vantł'ohtsit,” gavahnyąą.
